findings.current: How would a nobody like me recognize His Highness, Prince Shangshan?
findings.defect: The speaker recalls challenging the gambler’s claim, not doubting his own ability to recognize the prince.
findings.rationale: 네깟놈이 addresses the person who claimed to have seen the prince.
findings.replacement: How could the likes of you recognize His Highness, Prince Shangshan?

findings.current: His bloodline inherited the throne after defying the bonds of kinship—
findings.defect: This makes the bloodline inherit the throne; the speaker objects to the heir inheriting the Emperor’s blood.
findings.rationale: 핏줄을 물려받 refers to receiving the bloodline, while the Emperor is the one who took the throne.
findings.replacement: What blessing? The child will inherit the blood of a man who broke the bonds of kinship to take the throne—
findings.source: 천륜까지 어겨가며 그 자리에 오른 핏줄을 고스란히 물려받…….

findings.current: Every one of them was a master of martial arts, from First Rate to Peak.
findings.defect: First Rate lowers the stated minimum level of the guards.
findings.rationale: 초일류 is the established Supreme First Rate tier, not First Rate.
findings.replacement: Every one of them was a martial arts master at Supreme First Rate or Peak.
findings.source: 그들 한 사람, 한 사람이 초일류에서 절정의 무공을 익힌 고수들.

findings.defect: A shouted declaration of loyalty becomes a routine acknowledgment.
findings.rationale: 충 is the word for loyalty, delivered here with a formal military salute.

findings.current: We should stop him before he ruins the Great Nation’s great undertaking.
findings.defect: “Stop him” drops the Emperor’s qualification that Jin should be restrained only to an appropriate degree.
findings.rationale: 적당한 선에서 제지 specifies measured restraint, not an unqualified stop.
findings.replacement: We’d better rein him in before he jeopardizes the great undertaking.
findings.source: 대업을 망치기 전에 적당한 선에서 제지하는 게 좋겠군.

findings.current: ten men with their heads bowed beneath bamboo hats
findings.defect: The men have pulled their hats low; they have not bowed their heads.
findings.rationale: 눌러쓴 describes how the hats are worn.
findings.replacement: ten men with bamboo hats pulled low

summary: Several lines alter who acts or inherits, and the draft understates the guards’ martial rank.
